title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：welfare　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 welfare 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the warden ① provided the welfare that no resident in the centre would have measured, and he said the providing was the whole of the month. The ② welfare, meaning the benefit itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; welfare, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of welfare in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ welfare at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Welfare, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the warden said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the welfare was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the benefit. The ⑥ welfare, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; welfare, he said, is either something you provide or the only word that means both benefit and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ welfare had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ welfare of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of measuring; welfare, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ welfare I remember is the welfare measured in the register, which closed in 1971 and is still measured as the quietest in the centre. ⑩ Welfare, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all welfare, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like benefit. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 福利；福祉（指社区中心里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 福利；福祉（指那份福利本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：provide the welfare 提供这一份福利
D. n. 福利；福祉（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 福利之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的福利之事）
F. n. 福利；福祉（指登记册里写到、被测量的那一份）
G. n. 福利、体恤（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 体恤（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: provided the welfare that no resident in the centre would have measured
The welfare, meaning the benefit itself and not the notice
Every sort of welfare in that centre
the welfare at the far gate
the welfare was the whole of the matter
the welfare had become a line in a register
The welfare of the whole thing

answers.why: provide the welfare 意为“提供这一份福利”，1964 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯测量的一份福利做了一遍。
welfare 意为“福利；福祉”，指那份福利本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
welfare 意为“福利；福祉”，指社区中心里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
welfare 意为“福利；福祉”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
welfare 意为“福利、体恤”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份体恤就是那件事的全部。
welfare 意为“体恤”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份福利，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
welfare 意为“福利；福祉”，指登记册里写到、被测量的那一份，到 1969 年这一份成了登记册里的一行。
welfare 意为“福利之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的福利之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的测量。
welfare 意为“福利；福祉”，我记得的是登记册里测量过的那一份，1971 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一份。
welfare 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，福利是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的福利。
